remarks:
Discover the possibilities with this one-of-a-kind 8.7-acre property in the Town of Royalton, located within the Akron Central School District. Offering the perfect blend of open space and wooded privacy, this unique parcel has seen several improvements, including additional land clearing to create an even more functional and usable setting.

A private driveway leads to a secluded homesite featuring a 30’ x 50’ pole barn with a poured concrete floor, making it ideal for storage, a workshop, or future hobbies. Tucked behind the barn is a "tiny home" or mobile home, providing an excellent opportunity for a weekend retreat, temporary living space, or future renovation. Utilities will need to be connected, allowing the next owner to customize the property to their needs.

Whether you’re looking to build your dream home, create a private recreational getaway, or invest in a property with endless potential, this secluded setting offers the peace, privacy, and flexibility you’ve been searching for. Electric and public water are available at the road. Don’t miss this rare opportunity to own your own private escape!
